These commands are available three ways — in the FREE-WILi GUI app, in a serial
terminal, and on the device itself. See
[Connecting it to a computer](../start-here/connecting.md) for how to reach them.

## SPI1 Rx (12)

IO direction for SPI1 Rx pin 12 (out/in)

**How to use it** — press `a`.

## GPIO 26 (26)

IO direction for GPIO 26 (out/in)

**How to use it** — press `b`.

## SPI1 CS (13)

IO direction for SPI1 CS pin 13 (out/in)

**How to use it** — press `c`.

## GPIO (27)

IO direction for GPIO 27 (out/in)

**How to use it** — press `l`.

## UART1 Rx (9)

IO direction for UART1 Rx pin 9 (out/in)

**How to use it** — press `e`.

## UART1 CTS (10)

IO direction for UART1 CTS pin 10 (out/in)

**How to use it** — press `f`.

## UART1 Tx (8)

IO direction for UART1 Tx pin 8 (out/in)

**How to use it** — press `g`.

## UART1 RTS (11)

IO direction for UART1 RTS pin 11 (out/in)

**How to use it** — press `m`.

## SPI1 Tx (15)

IO direction for SPI1 Tx pin 15 (out/in)

**How to use it** — press `i`.

## SPI1 SCLK (14)

IO direction for SPI1 SCLK pin 14 (out/in)

**How to use it** — press `j`.

## GPIO25 (25)

IO direction for GPIO 25 (out/in)

**How to use it** — press `k`.
